The Vendetta Gazette

Vol. XII • June 8, 2026 • “All the Blood That’s Fit to Print” • Two Cents (If You’re Still Alive to Pay)

★ TERRITORY GAINS THIS WEEK ★ Sir Caprice        +48 turfs
Donald Trump      +14 turfs
Free Willy         +11 turfs
Ramon             +1 turf
Cokro              +1 turf
Wu-Tang           +1 turf

The Titan Stumbles — But Does Not Fall

Sir Caprice Returns a Diminished Conqueror; Yet Still the Mightiest Hand Upon the Map By Our Man in the Trenches, Ignatius P. Flambeau

Last week, this correspondent was compelled to reach for superlatives not yet coined in the English language, as Sir Caprice — that magnificent, merciless tempest in a double-breasted suit — swept one hundred and ten turfs into his already-groaning empire in a single week of breathtaking conquest. Vendetta City quaked. Rivals wept into their bootleg bourbon. The map was redrawn in his image.

And this week? Forty-eight turfs. Only forty-eight.

Gentle readers, do not mistake a lessening of fury for a lessening of dominance. Sir Caprice remains the undisputed sovereign of territorial aggression, launching fifty captures upon the crumbling domains of the hapless Gpug GIka, a poor wretch who surrendered forty-eight lots without — so far as this reporter can determine — mounting any meaningful resistance whatsoever. Combined with thirty-two surgical raids upon those same diminished holdings, Sir Caprice stripped Gpug GIka of cash, arms, and dignity in roughly equal measure. The total garrison of Sir Caprice now stands at a staggering 5,707 souls under arms. If this is the great man slowing down, heaven help us all when he picks up the pace again.

The Platinum Pompadour Takes His Pound of Flesh

Donald Trump Carves Fourteen Turfs from Wcrypto's Withering Empire By Our Man in the Trenches, Ignatius P. Flambeau

Not content to watch Sir Caprice hoard all the glory, Donald Trump, the Platinum Pompadour of Vendetta City, trained his considerable guns upon one Wcrypto this week, seizing fourteen turfs through fifteen calculated territorial assaults and following each conquest with the twist of the knife that is his trademark — fourteen additional raids upon those same beleaguered streets. Wcrypto, down forty-four garrison units and now a shadow of his former self at a mere 328 soldiers, appears to be a man whose empire is dissolving like sugar in the rain.

Most audacious of all was Trump's brazen raid upon the vaults of Blood Captain — a single strike that netted a clean five hundred dollars cash, five hundred arms, and nearly thirty experience points in one fell swoop. The maximum haul. The perfect crime. This correspondent tipped his hat and then quickly put it back on, lest it too be stolen.

It must be noted, however, that even as Trump expanded his frontier, his garrison shed forty-four units this week, now resting at 5,606. Whether those men were lost in the fighting or quietly reassigned, the Pompadour's war machine runs hot and burns through fuel accordingly.

★ Special Bulletin: HQ Stormed on Mulberry Lane ★ It is with equal parts admiration and horror that this Gazette reports the elimination of Royce roll — a small-time operator holding but a single turf — at the hands of Free Willy, that unpredictable bruiser of the waterfront district. On the 26th of May, Free Willy's enforcers descended upon Royce roll's headquarters with the subtlety of a runaway brewery wagon, overran the garrison, and planted their colours upon the smoking ruins. Royce roll, having possessed no further turfs to promote to a new HQ, was eliminated outright from Vendetta City — his name now consigned to the register of the vanished. Free W
